title: How does the app know which sessions are live and what they are working on?
context: Only matters for agents the hub did not start itself (terminal sessions joining later through a channel). If the hub hosts its agents (decision 1), it already knows which are live, and this can be dropped or parked until a channel is added.

options.name: Sessions register with a hook
options.summary: A SessionStart hook writes session id, folder and transcript path to ~/crux/sessions/; a SessionEnd hook removes it.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='10' y='65' width='80' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='50' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Session</text><line x1='90' y1='90' x2='118' y2='90' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='118,90 111.7,93.0 111.7,87.0' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='120' y='65' width='90' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='165' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Registry</text><line x1='210' y1='90' x2='238' y2='90' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='238,90 231.7,93.0 231.7,87.0' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='240' y='65' width='70' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='275' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Crux app</text><text x='105' y='140' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>start / end hook</text></svg>
pros: Exact: the session says it exists
Gives the session id the inbox needs
cons: A crash leaves a stale entry, so the app must check it is still alive
The hook must be installed in your user settings

options.name: Read Claude Code's own session files
options.summary: Scan ~/.claude/projects for transcripts and treat recently changed ones as live.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='10' y='65' width='80' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='50' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Session</text><line x1='90' y1='90' x2='118' y2='90' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='118,90 111.7,93.0 111.7,87.0' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='120' y='65' width='90' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='165' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Transcripts</text><line x1='210' y1='90' x2='238' y2='90' stroke='currentColor' stroke-dasharray='4 3'/><polygon points='238,90 231.7,93.0 231.7,87.0' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='240' y='65' width='70' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='275' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Crux app</text><text x='225' y='140' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>guess from age</text></svg>
cons: Internal format, not a published interface
"Live" is a guess from file age

options.name: Sessions tag the decisions they touch
options.summary: The skill writes the session id into a record when it creates or edits it.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='10' y='65' width='80' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='50' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Session</text><line x1='90' y1='90' x2='118' y2='90' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='118,90 111.7,93.0 111.7,87.0' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='120' y='65' width='90' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='165' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Record JSON</text><line x1='210' y1='90' x2='238' y2='90' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='238,90 231.7,93.0 231.7,87.0' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='240' y='65' width='70' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='275' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Crux app</text><text x='165' y='140' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>session id field</text></svg>
pros: Links a decision straight to the session that owns it
cons: Only knows sessions that touched Crux
Says nothing about whether the session is still open

recommendation: It is the only option that actually knows a session is open, and it hands the inbox the session id it needs; tagging records (C) can be added on top for the decision link.
